verification_policy.reason_live_probe_not_performed: No credentials are committed or available to CI; production capability is conditional on account authorization and API/app permissions.

official_sources.note: Official Instagram API workspace states the API supports professional accounts and gathering insights.
Current Graph API line is v26.0, released 2026-07-29; v20.0 was removed 2026-09-24.

Canonical media-insights reference. Automated retrieval is blocked in this environment, so runtime uses capability probing and fails closed per metric rather than assuming every listed metric exists for every login path/account/media.

explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.impressions: Deprecated/removed from current media-insights path; views is not treated as the same metric.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.completed_views: No direct completed-view count is assumed.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.retention_points: No current per-reel retention curve is normalized by this adapter.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.follows: Per-reel follows availability varies by login path/media and is not assumed.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.link_clicks: Not a Reel metric in this adapter.

production_blockers: Meta app/account authorization and required insight permissions
Metric availability varies by login flow, media age/type and account eligibility

official_sources.note: Query Videos verifies IDs belong to the authorized user, supports up to 20 IDs and requires video.list.
Current Content Display Video Object exposes view_count, like_count, comment_count and share_count.
User access token is 24h; refresh token is 365d. Tokens remain external to Growth durable evidence.

youtube_shorts.api_family: YouTube Data API v3 plus YouTube Analytics API v2

official_sources.note: Video statistics exposes viewCount, likeCount and commentCount. Starting 2026-08-24, viewCount for all formats including Shorts counts when playback begins, including autoplay/hover/click/tap.
Current core metrics include engagedViews, views, estimatedMinutesWatched, averageViewDuration, likes, comments, shares and subscribersGained.
reports.query is authorized, supports video filters, and currently requires youtube.readonly access; yt-analytics.readonly grants analytics report access.

explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.watch_time_seconds: Requires analytics authorization and data availability.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.average_watch_duration_seconds: Requires analytics authorization and data availability.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.shares: Requires analytics authorization and data availability.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.follows: Mapped from subscribersGained when analytics authorization/data are available.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.completed_views: No direct completed-view count is assumed.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.retention_points: A separate audience-retention report shape is not normalized in R17.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.saves: No selected API metric maps to Growth saves.
explicitly_unavailable_or_conditional.link_clicks: No selected API metric maps to post link clicks.

production_blockers: Analytics data can lag Data API counters

http_error_classification.5xx: temporary provider outage with bounded backoff

runtime_semantics.partial_metrics: available metrics are normalized; omitted/unsupported metrics remain null with unavailable_evidence
runtime_semantics.counter_revisions: higher provider capture revisions may legitimately change counters; older revisions are rejected as stale
runtime_semantics.clock_skew: collections fail into bounded temporary retry when local clock is materially behind the requested window
runtime_semantics.synthetic_live_separation: mock_fixture becomes synthetic_fixture and can never claim live platform performance
